messages.cli.forge.stage.update: the update of the branch (the base branch merged in, the generators, every check)
messages.cli.forge.reason.secret: a line the branch or one of its commits adds holds a secret (a treasury value or a key's shape); a push sends every commit, so a later commit that removes it is not enough: take it out of the branch's history (git reset --soft to the base branch, then commit again, for one), change the secret if it may have leaked, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.push_refused: git or the territory's pre-push hook refused the push; read the push log (.runs/<quest>-delivery/push.log), fix it, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.no_credential: git has no credential for the forge; sign in (git credential, Git Credential Manager), then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.forge_auth: the forge refused the credential (expired, revoked, no push access, or SSO); sign in again, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.forge_error: the forge could not answer (the network, the time limit, a server error, no adapter in this Steward); deliver again later.
messages.cli.forge.reason.conflict: the branch cannot merge with the base branch (files no rule of shared_paths resolves, or the base branch overtook it too often); resolve the conflict on the branch, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.checks_red: a check is red: a required check of the pull request, or a check of the territory on the branch with the base branch merged in (.runs/<quest>-delivery/checks/); read it, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.checks_timeout: a required check of the pull request had not ended in time; read it, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.head_moved: the branch's head on the forge is not the one the Steward pushed; see who pushed, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.generate_failed: a command of commands.generate failed after the base branch was merged in; read its log (.runs/<quest>-delivery/generate.log), fix it, then deliver again.
messages.cli.forge.reason.update_failed: git, a hook or commands.setup refused the update of the branch (the merge, a commit of the Steward, a git older than 2.38); read the detail, fix it, then deliver again.
